info.name: School OS API
info.description:
Generated from the School OS OpenAPI document (`npm run postman:generate`).

1. Select the **School OS — Local** environment and set `schoolPassword` (your SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD) and the platform credentials.
2. Run **Auth → POST /auth/login** (stores `accessToken`) and **Platform Auth → POST /platform/auth/login** (stores `platformAccessToken`).
3. Run a list request (e.g. **Students → GET /students**) before its detail requests — list and create requests save ids such as `{{studentId}}` automatically.
4. Requests marked ⚠ change or delete data.

Access tokens last 15 minutes: when you get `TOKEN_EXPIRED`, run the login (or refresh) request again.

item.name: POST /users — Create a login account

request.description:
Create a login account

Role grants are enforced: the Admin can create any role; principals cannot create Admins/principals; office administrators can create teacher and parent accounts. Teaching staff: a teacher login is provisioned in the same request (status `pending`; the activation token is returned once in `account.activation`). Non-teaching staff: no login unless `login.create` is true, with a staff role (and `customRoleId` for custom roles). Requires `users:manage` to create logins; without it the employee is saved and `accountSkipped` explains why.
